mechanism: Cenobamate is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2C19; trimethoprim may inhibit these enzymes and increase cenobamate levels, while cenobamate may induce CYP3A4 affecting trimethoprim metabolism.
action: Monitor cenobamate levels and seizure control; consider dose adjustment of cenobamate if used concurrently; assess for increased adverse effects.
